verdict.rationale: Dover is a recruiting/ATS platform, so user-configurable background automations (triggers, rules, autonomous workflows) are a fair question for it. The evidence only shows adjacent features: built-in AI applicant scoring, outreach email campaigns, default schedule/reject templates and bulk actions. None of these is documented as an automation a user sets up to run autonomously in the background.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
